text: Dobu (also known as Dobuan; ISO 639-3: dob) is an Austronesian language of the Oceanic branch, spoken primarily by communities in the Milne Bay Province of Papua New Guinea, including southeastern Fergusson Island, northern Normanby Island, and the offshore islands of Dobu, Sanaroa, and Tewara.
